Shizuku exposes privileged system APIs to user apps without root, by running a small service started via wireless ADB or root. Three compatible providers are supported — Shizuku (RikkaApps), AXManager (Axeron), and Sui (a Magisk/KernelSU module for rooted devices); install any one. Install any one of Shizuku (RikkaApps), AXManager (Axeron), or Sui (RikkaApps) — all three implement the same protocol and are fully interchangeable. Shizuku and AXManager are regular apps activated via wireless ADB. Sui is for already-rooted devices: it installs as a Magisk/KernelSU module, needs no app, and stays active across reboots. On KernelSU or APatch, Sui also requires a Zygisk implementation (Zygisk Next / ReZygisk / NeoZygisk) — without it Sui will not load. Install one, then return here.
